thread:
ravi: heads-up: saw a perf regression on int4 path for long sequences on SM95 during nightly runs. throughput dropped ~25% for some models.
ada: ugh. timeline?
ravi: surfaced in the 02:00 perf sweep. baseline (before change) was ~72k toks/s, after change ~54k on same workload.
leo: any flamegraph / nsight traces?
ravi: yes, attached snapshot in the sweep run. main diff shows kernel picker choosing kernel_v2_int4_fused for seq>=1024 instead of kernel_v1_int4_chunked. lots of stalled warps + expensive shared mem ops.
sang: curious — kernel_v2 was supposed to be better for medium seqlen; maybe autotuner boundary shifted incorrectly. did autotune re-run last night?
ravi: autotune did a full sweep, but the score_margin was tightened to 0.03 last week; looks like that made the selector prefer v2 for seqlen 1024..1536.
perf-bot: perf alert: model "rwd-13b" mapping: autoselect change at 02:07 UTC. drop -25% tokens/s. rollback recommended if not fixed within 2 hours. :warning:
ada: can we reproduce locally with the same batch/seqlen distribution?
leo: i ran a local microbench with sequences [128,512,1024,1536] and saw the same pick flip. repro script: `./bench --model rwd-13b --quant int4 --sm 95 --batch 1 --seqlen 1536`
sang: logs show kv cache chunking differs between kernels. v1 used `kv_chunk_size=256`, v2 uses single-shot kv write. for long seqs the single-shot path thrashes shared mem.
ravi: attaching quick profiler notes:
```
- nsight: high shared memory stalls on kernel_v2_int4_fused
- l2 traffic up 30% on kv writes
- warp efficiency down 18%
```
ada: so fix options: 1) tweak autotune boundaries (seqlen_threshold), 2) add hysteresis / safety_margin so minor score deltas don't flip, 3) fallback for seq>1024 to v1 for SM95 int4.
leo: i prefer 2 + 3. hysteresis avoids noisy flips in production. add a safety rule: if delta_score < 0.05 and previous kernel == v1 keep v1 for next 5 mins.
sang: agree. also think we should add kv warmup for v2 (small prefix warmup to prime shared mem) — could reduce stalls.
ravi: drafted autotune config patch:
```
{"autotune": {
  "score_margin": "0.05",
  "hysteresis_window_secs": "300",
  "seqlen_buckets": ["0-511","512-1023","1024-4096"],
  "preferred_kernel_overrides": {"sm95_int4": {"1024-4096": "kernel_v1_int4_chunked"}}
}}
```
perf-bot: suggested rollout: canary 5% traffic for 30m, measure tokens/s and p95 latency. auto-rollback if tokens/s drops >5% or p95 > 2x.
ada: who owns the patch? ravi?
ravi: i'll open PR with tests + microbench traces. pinging @deploy-bot for canary plan when merged.
deploy-bot: received. will schedule canary once PR merged and jobs pass.
leo: follow-up: we should also add an instrumentation counter in runtime: `kernel_choice_reason` tagged with `seqlen_bucket` and `score_delta` so we can analyze drift over time. short-term logs are messy.
sang: good call. i'll add the counter. also adding a quick test to confirm kv_chunk_size preserved across paths.
ravi: thanks team. plan: PR in next 30m, canary config per perf-bot, monitor. will loop back with post-canary numbers. :+1:
